articles.body:
Hello,

Our six regional offices handle their own cases but need to see what the other regions have decided, for consistency. Today they either see everything with full rights or only their own region.

Is a read-only view across regions possible without giving edit rights?

Best regards,
Håkan Nyberg
articles.subject: Role for regional offices with read-only on other regions

articles.body:
Hi Håkan,

Yes, that is the Regional handler role combined with the Cross-region read permission. The combination gives edit rights inside the user's own region and read-only everywhere else. Decisions and attachments are visible, internal notes from other regions are not.

Do you want me to set it up for one office first so you can look at it?

Best,
Mia
articles.subject: Re: Role for regional offices with read-only on other regions

articles.body:
We tried it in the north office and it is exactly right. Please apply it to the remaining five.

Håkan Nyberg
Programme director
